briefText: SGB Energie GmbH sells electricity and gas to businesses in Germany. Its price model is a mix of exchange prices and fixed prices. A personal advisor from a network of over 500 experts looks after each customer. The switch to SGB is free and digital. An owner can book a call with an advisor, or sign a contract online. We believe that energy is a big cost for a restaurant or a hotel. Yet the owner rarely looks at it: the bill arrives, and they pay it. And when someone calls about energy, they hang up. Make these owners want to find out what SGB would mean for them. Owners do not choose to stay with their supplier. They miss the day they could leave. My SGB advisor calls me before every notice date, even SGB's own.

facts.statement: A Germany-wide network of over 500 experts
Advisors visit the customer on site
Advisors call the customer before every notice date, SGB's own contracts included
The switch to SGB is free for all customers
After the signature, SGB cancels the old contract or takes it over
An individual mix of spot and fixed prices, terms from 1 to 60 months
SGB VZ FLEX: cancel every month
SGB Portfolio: terms of 12, 24 or 36 months; one month notice; without notice it renews by 12 months
Since March 2022 a household energy contract may only roll on month by month; a business contract renews as written
facts.source: energiehelden24.nrw, Gewerbestrom kündigen (read 10 Nov 2026); Verbraucherzentrale Niedersachsen

quotes.speaker: Christian Bleitner
quotes.original: Bei der SGB habe ich einen festen Ansprechpartner. So etwas kenne ich nicht von anderen Versorgern.
quotes.translation: At SGB, I have one fixed contact person. I do not know that from other suppliers.

quotes.speaker: Christian Andresen
quotes.original: Dank der SGB konnten wir von den günstigen Spotmarkt-Preisen profitieren.
quotes.translation: Thanks to SGB, we could profit from the low spot market prices.

quotes.speaker: Thomas Gödtel
quotes.original: Durch die SGB kann ich einiges an Geld sparen.
quotes.translation: Through SGB, I can save a good amount of money.

quotes.speaker: Henning Wagner
quotes.original: Mein persönlicher SGB-Berater kümmert sich um alles.
quotes.translation: My personal SGB advisor takes care of everything.

quotes.speaker: Wolf Wallendorf
quotes.original: Dank SGB haben wir wieder Mittel, um zu investieren.
quotes.translation: Thanks to SGB, we have money to invest again.

quotes.speaker: Karl Pichlmeyer
quotes.original: SGB analysiert den ganzjährigen Lastgang und kauft Strom nicht zum höchsten Preis ein.
quotes.translation: SGB analyses the load profile across the whole year and does not buy electricity at the highest price.

quotes.speaker: Catharina Riem
quotes.original: Der Wechsel zu SGB spart uns Arbeitszeit und bringt finanzielle Vorteile.
quotes.translation: The switch to SGB saves us working time and brings financial benefits.

quotes.speaker: Tobias Averbeck
quotes.original: Wer Energiesicherheit und Kostensicherheit hat, hat die halbe Miete im Betriebsablauf.
quotes.translation: Whoever has secure energy and secure costs is halfway there in running the operation.

quotes.speaker: Christian Stock
quotes.original: Ich habe durch den Wechsel zu SGB deutlich Geld gespart.
quotes.translation: Through the switch to SGB, I saved a noticeable amount of money.

quotes.speaker: Cord Pleis
quotes.original: Ich muss mir keine Sorgen um falsch berechnete Energiekosten machen.
quotes.translation: I do not have to worry about wrongly calculated energy costs.

quotes.speaker: Tolga Sagdic
quotes.original: Bei der SGB überzeugte mich die persönliche und lösungsorientierte Kundenbetreuung.
quotes.translation: At SGB, the personal and solution-focused customer care convinced me.

quotes.speaker: Gordon von Godin
quotes.original: Transparente Abrechnung und persönlicher Kontakt sind mir wichtig.
quotes.translation: Transparent billing and personal contact are important to me.

quotes.speaker: Mirja Kuschur
quotes.original: Ich kann jedem nur raten, mit der SGB Energie zusammenzuarbeiten.
quotes.translation: I can only advise everyone to work with SGB Energie.
